subject: Starting Exa harvest: Jennifer Doudna
body: Public-track harvest for data/researchers/jennifer_doudna, 2012-01-01 to 2026-11-14, ~$2 Exa. Listings: arXiv + new autoresearch/taste/pubmed.py (321 PubMed papers, PMC full-text URLs). Uses the uncommitted lab= support in scrape.py from the owain-evans-harvest session as it sits on disk; I have not edited scrape.py or timesplit.py. Owner of those files: consider a --pubmed flag in timesplit harvest that calls list_pubmed_author(name, start, end).
